description: The surface of the Chrono Dawn Mountain biome looks varied and right. The player enters the dimension at 0 0 first, so the Time Keeper Village (placed near wherever a player first enters) stays away from what this scenario looks at.

steps.command: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run locate biome chronodawn:chronodawn_mountain

steps: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run spreadplayers 0 0 0 1 false ${player}
execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run spreadplayers ${x} ${z} 0 1 false ${player}

steps.note: The Mountain biome, looking south and down from 40 blocks above the ground. Steep slopes show a mixed rock face (stone, cobblestone, mossy cobblestone and Duskstone), not one flat block. Rock, grass and snow meet without hard straight lines, and nothing floats on the slopes. No magenta-black missing textures.

The Mountain biome closer to the ground, looking west. Steep slopes show a mixed rock face (stone, cobblestone, mossy cobblestone and Duskstone), not one flat block. Rock, grass and snow meet without hard straight lines, and nothing floats on the slopes.
